comment: Read at commit d55cb70. The operating mode is a CM_OP widget at CatroModulo.hpp:906, a plain Button rather than a ParamWidget: it is saved in the patch, it changes what every output does, and because it has no ParamQuantity it can never be clicked for help. Whether the module routes one signal to eight or eight to one is decided by which jacks are patched rather than by any control: with no row inputs and no single input it makes gates instead. The reset jack is read only inside the branch that requires the clk jack to be patched, so a reset with no clock does nothing. Eight row inputs, eight row outputs and the single input and output carry whatever is patched through them, so none of them is given a family. Nothing here is polyphonic.
